violation_type.title: Parent right to review video recordings of alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving parent child (26 TAC §746.521(8))
violation_type.short_title: Parent right to review video recordings of alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving parent child
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained, the operation did not provide parents the opportunity to review an alleged incident of abuse when it was requested.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained, the operation did not provide parents the opportunity to review an alleged incident of abuse when it was requested.
The director did not make video footage available for review when parent asked.

This standard was reviewed in relation to the reported allegations and found to be deficient. The operation admitted that they did not get the parents permission to show the video to another parent before showing the video.
Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a parent was not provided the right to review video footage of an incident involving their child.

The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation.  Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined that the parents weren't allowed access to video footage of an incident of involving neglect of their child.

After review of a DFPS investigation, it was determined the operation denied parent video when requested regarding an altercation involving their child.  This situation was to the level of abuse/neglect investigation.
